comparison.objective: Candidate attaches an outer rack rail to front and rear rack posts; record inserts an inner slide member through a ball retainer into an already positioned slide channel.
comparison.physical_skill: Both test long slide-part alignment and controlled insertion. Candidate emphasizes bimanual leveling across separated posts, spring-prong latching, telescoping adjustment, and screw driving; record emphasizes moving a ball retainer and rolling an inner member between its rollers without shoving it.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks four post prongs, spring extension, same rack unit, prescribed screws, and self-support; record checks retainer-at-front history, correct roller engagement, riding pose, and home stop.
comparison.reason: They concern different rail assembly interfaces and failure modes: rack-post attachment versus inner-member/ball-retainer engagement. Candidate must retain the full front/rear latch-and-fastener rubric; its numeric alignment, insertion, and overload thresholds are presently missing.
